# Stories every user shares

The sign-in, page frame, inbox, uploads, and assistant that every persona uses.

## Web shell

What every persona shares: sign-in, the page frame and menu, persona context, to-do home pages, the inbox, the Uploads page, table downloads, change history, and Saved Reports.

<a id="req-shell-0001"></a>

### Work in a phone browser

`REQ-SHELL-0001`

- **Who:** Instawork Admin, Program User, Unit User, Agency User
- **What:** Every Iris page works in a phone browser as well as on a desktop, because Unit Users and Agency Users work on the go.
- **Why:** Operators and agencies work on the go *(PLT-3: Web app usable on mobile)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) PLT-3

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** Every page, including sign-in and the password link pages, works in a phone browser with no app to install.
- **R2.** At a width of 360 px no page scrolls sideways, and a table too wide for the screen scrolls inside its own area.
- **R3.** On a phone the menu collapses behind one button, and every action a desktop offers is also offered there.
- **R4.** A file can be sent from a phone, including a photo taken with its camera, such as a paper sign-in sheet.

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-116](open-questions.md#d-116) What is the narrowest phone screen every page must work on?

<a id="req-shell-0002"></a>

### Show who the User is acting as and let them switch

`REQ-SHELL-0002` · first slice

- **Who:** Instawork Admin, Program User, Unit User, Agency User
- **What:** Every page shows the role the signed-in User is acting in and its scope, such as an Agency or a Unit. A User whose Role Grants give more than one context chooses which to act in.
- **Why:** Each persona gets its own view *(PLT-1: RBAC: unit (buyer), agency (supplier), corporate/program owner)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) PLT-1; [Demo feedback](https://docs.google.com/document/d/14AQi9DSbYzvEEijmSjCUajHHymowKWYXTPcO3hDEkWc/edit) show visually that we're talking like supplier vs buyer vs corporate

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** A User acts in one context at a time, as [`REQ-ORG-0009.R9`](business-rules.md#req-org-0009) defines it, so all their UNIT_USER grants make one context and each Agency makes its own.
- **R2.** Only unrevoked Role Grants give a context, and a User with none sees a page that says they have no access and offers only sign out.
- **R3.** A User with one context starts in it after sign-in; a User with several is asked to choose one at each sign-in, and can switch from any page without signing out.
- **R4.** Every page shows the acting role and its scope: the org nodes of the UNIT_USER grants, the Agency's name, or the whole program.
- **R5.** Entering a context, at sign-in or by switching, opens the Home that its role's menu requirement adds, shows that role's menu, and changes no product record.
- **R6.** The chosen role and context are saved on the User's session through [`REQ-IDENTITY-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0001), in the form [`REQ-ORG-0009`](business-rules.md#req-org-0009) defines, so every request carries them.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-ORG-0005` Grant a role within a scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0005)
- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)
- [`REQ-AGENCIES-0001` Add an Agency](business-rules.md#req-agencies-0001)

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-61](open-questions.md#d-61) How does a User with several roles choose and switch the one they act in?
- [D-81](open-questions.md#d-81) Does a User who holds several Role Grants act with all of them at once, or only as the role they chose?
- [D-107](open-questions.md#d-107) How can the first slice be used before every screen and feature exists?
- [D-221](open-questions.md#d-221) Where is the role a User is acting in kept?

<a id="req-shell-0003"></a>

### Lead each home page with to-dos

`REQ-SHELL-0003`

- **Who:** Program User, Unit User, Agency User
- **What:** Each persona's home page opens on its to-dos: one line for each kind of task, with a count and what is at stake. Each persona's to-do requirement names its tasks.
- **Why:** Not given in Compass's sheet; the sources below are where it comes from.
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §1 How Todos behave

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The to-do list has one line per kind of task, with the number waiting and what is at stake: a dollar amount, the oldest one's age, or the nearest deadline.
- **R2.** Each line opens the screen where that work is done, filtered to exactly the records the line counts.
- **R3.** A line counts only records still in the state that defines its task, so a record leaves the count as soon as its task is done.
- **R4.** A task with nothing waiting shows no line, and a list with no line says there is nothing to do.
- **R5.** On every page, the Home item of the menu shows the total of all lines, and shows no number when the total is zero.
- **R6.** Home opens on the to-do list when the total is above zero, and otherwise on the second section its persona's to-do requirement names, when it names one.
- **R7.** Every count covers only records inside the scope of the acting role, as [`REQ-ORG-0009`](business-rules.md#req-org-0009) limits each list.
- **R8.** Counts and stakes are computed from current records each time a page loads, and no to-do is stored.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-120](open-questions.md#d-120) Are to-dos stored, or worked out each time a page loads?

<a id="req-shell-0004"></a>

### Sign in with email and password

`REQ-SHELL-0004` · first slice

- **Who:** Instawork Admin, Program User, Unit User, Agency User
- **What:** A User of any role signs in on one page with their email and password. The page offers no sign-up.
- **Why:** MSP task: profile and password management *(PLT-4: User accounts with login, profiles and password management)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) PLT-4

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The sign-in page takes an email and a password, calls [`REQ-IDENTITY-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0001), and on success hands the User to [`REQ-SHELL-0002`](#req-shell-0002), which sets their context and opens its Home.
- **R2.** A refused sign-in shows one message that does not say whether the email, the password, or a deactivated User was the cause, and keeps the email typed.
- **R3.** Opening any signed-in page without a session shows the sign-in page instead.
- **R4.** The page has no way to create an account, because a User exists only by invite.
- **R5.** One page serves Unit Users, Agency Users, Program Users, and Instawork Admins, and never asks for a role.

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-25](open-questions.md#d-25) Who manages Users?
- [D-61](open-questions.md#d-61) How does a User with several roles choose and switch the one they act in?
- [D-98](open-questions.md#d-98) When does a sign-in end?
- [D-117](open-questions.md#d-117) Do the sign-in and reset pages reveal whether an email has an account?

<a id="req-shell-0005"></a>

### Set a password from an invite or reset link

`REQ-SHELL-0005` · first slice

- **Who:** Instawork Admin, Program User, Unit User, Agency User
- **What:** A User opens the single-use link from an invite or a reset email and sets a password. Anyone can ask for a reset link by entering an email.
- **Why:** MSP task: profile and password management *(PLT-4: User accounts with login, profiles and password management)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) PLT-4

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The reset request page takes an email, calls [`REQ-IDENTITY-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0002), and then shows the same message whether or not that email belongs to a User.
- **R2.** A link [`REQ-IDENTITY-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0002) accepts opens a page that shows the User's email, which cannot be changed, and a field for a new password.
- **R3.** A password shorter than 12 characters is refused on the page with that reason, and the link can still be used.
- **R4.** A link that is unknown, used, expired, or belongs to a deactivated User shows that it no longer works, offers the reset request, and shows no password field.
- **R5.** Once the password is saved, the page says so and leads to the sign-in page of [`REQ-SHELL-0004`](#req-shell-0004); it starts no session.
- **R6.** This requirement adds to the sign-in page of [`REQ-SHELL-0004`](#req-shell-0004) a link to its reset request page.

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-34](open-questions.md#d-34) How long does an invite or reset link work?
- [D-107](open-questions.md#d-107) How can the first slice be used before every screen and feature exists?
- [D-117](open-questions.md#d-117) Do the sign-in and reset pages reveal whether an email has an account?
- [D-171](open-questions.md#d-171) What is the shortest password Iris accepts?

<a id="req-shell-0006"></a>

### See and change your own profile

`REQ-SHELL-0006`

- **Who:** Instawork Admin, Program User, Unit User, Agency User
- **What:** A signed-in User sees their own profile and Role Grants, and changes their name and phone. They change their password by an emailed reset link.
- **Why:** MSP task: profile and password management *(PLT-4: User accounts with login, profiles and password management)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) PLT-4

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The account menu of [`REQ-SHELL-0009`](#req-shell-0009) offers Profile, a page that shows the User's first name, last name, email, phone, and each unrevoked Role Grant with its role and scope.
- **R2.** The User changes their first name, last name, and phone through [`REQ-IDENTITY-0003`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0003), and the email is shown but cannot be changed.
- **R4.** Change password sends the User a reset link through [`REQ-IDENTITY-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0002) and says it was emailed; the page has no password field.
- **R5.** The page offers no change to the User's own Role Grants or active flag.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-ORG-0005` Grant a role within a scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0005)
- [`REQ-AGENCIES-0001` Add an Agency](business-rules.md#req-agencies-0001)

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-25](open-questions.md#d-25) Who manages Users?
- [D-107](open-questions.md#d-107) How can the first slice be used before every screen and feature exists?
- [D-171](open-questions.md#d-171) What is the shortest password Iris accepts?
- [D-172](open-questions.md#d-172) Which of their own details can a User change?

<a id="req-shell-0007"></a>

### Read in-app notifications in an inbox

`REQ-SHELL-0007` · first slice

- **Who:** Instawork Admin, Program User, Unit User, Agency User
- **What:** Every page leads to an inbox of the User's in-app notifications, newest first. Opening one marks it read and opens the page registered for the record it is about.
- **Why:** Not given in Compass's sheet; the sources below are where it comes from.
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) Overview

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The frame of [`REQ-SHELL-0009`](#req-shell-0009) has an inbox control that shows how many of the User's IN_APP notifications have no read_at.
- **R2.** The inbox lists only the signed-in User's IN_APP notifications, newest first, each with its body, when it was sent, and whether it is read.
- **R3.** Opening a notification marks it read through [`REQ-MESSAGING-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-messaging-0001).
- **R4.** EMAIL and SMS notifications are never listed, and an inbox with nothing in it says so.
- **R5.** The inbox holds the notifications of every context the User has, whichever one they are acting in.
- **R6.** Opening a notification then opens the page a screen requirement registered for its subject entity and the acting role, at its subject record, and does nothing else when none is registered.

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-107](open-questions.md#d-107) How can the first slice be used before every screen and feature exists?
- [D-118](open-questions.md#d-118) What does the in-app inbox show?
- [D-252](open-questions.md#d-252) Which record is each notification about?

<a id="req-shell-0008"></a>

### Send files, get templates, and follow uploads on the Uploads page

`REQ-SHELL-0008`

- **Who:** Program User, Unit User, Agency User
- **What:** On the Uploads page a User sends a file, downloads the templates their role may use, and follows their own Uploads. An Upload waiting for review opens its Proposal.
- **Why:** Not given in Compass's sheet; the sources below are where it comes from.
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §6 Uploads

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The page has an upload type picker, a template download, and a file chooser, and offers only the upload types registered under [`REQ-INTAKE-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0001) whose uploaders include the acting role.
- **R2.** Download template gives the picked type's template, as CSV or Excel, through [`REQ-INTAKE-0003`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0003), and is not offered for a type that has none.
- **R3.** Sending a file calls [`REQ-INTAKE-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0001) with the picked type, or with none so that Iris detects it, and the new Upload shows at the top of the log.
- **R4.** Below, the page shows the upload log as [`REQ-INTAKE-0004`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0004) defines it, including files the User sent in the assistant or by email or text.
- **R5.** An IN_REVIEW line opens its Proposal in the card of [`REQ-ASSISTANT-0002`](#req-assistant-0002), and a SAVED or DISCARDED line opens the same card read-only.
- **R6.** A NEEDS_TYPE line asks the User to pick the type, which calls [`REQ-INTAKE-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0001) again, and a FAILED line shows its failure_reason.
- **R8.** Another screen can open the send step with one upload type already picked, such as SHIFTS from the Shifts list.
- **R9.** The Uploads item of the menu shows how many of the User's Uploads are IN_REVIEW or NEEDS_TYPE.

<a id="req-shell-0009"></a>

### Frame every signed-in page with the acting role's menu

`REQ-SHELL-0009` · first slice

- **Who:** Instawork Admin, Program User, Unit User, Agency User
- **What:** Every page after sign-in sits in one frame with a menu of the screens for the role the User is acting in and an account menu. It never lists a screen that role cannot use.
- **Why:** Each persona gets its own view *(PLT-1: RBAC: unit (buyer), agency (supplier), corporate/program owner)*
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) Pages; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) PLT-1

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** Every page after sign-in shows one frame: the menu, the name of the page, and the account menu.
- **R2.** The menu lists only the screens of the acting role, in the order its menu requirement gives ([`REQ-UNIT-WEB-0001`](unit-user.md#req-unit-web-0001), [`REQ-AGENCY-WEB-0001`](agency-user.md#req-agency-web-0001), [`REQ-PROGRAM-WEB-0001`](program-user.md#req-program-web-0001), or [`REQ-ADMIN-WEB-0001`](instawork-admin.md#req-admin-web-0001)), with Home first.
- **R3.** Opening a screen or record the User's Role Grants do not cover shows the refusal of [`REQ-ORG-0009`](business-rules.md#req-org-0009) and a link to Home, and nothing of the record.
- **R4.** The account menu shows the User's first name, last name, and email, and offers sign out.
- **R5.** Sign out ends the session through [`REQ-IDENTITY-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0001) and shows the sign-in page of [`REQ-SHELL-0004`](#req-shell-0004).
- **R6.** When [`REQ-IDENTITY-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-identity-0001) refuses a request because the session ended or the User was deactivated, the sign-in page of [`REQ-SHELL-0004`](#req-shell-0004) replaces the frame.
- **R7.** Each screen's requirement adds its own item to its role's menu, so the menu shows an item only once that screen is delivered.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

<a id="req-shell-0010"></a>

### Download any table as CSV

`REQ-SHELL-0010` · first slice

- **Who:** Instawork Admin, Program User, Unit User, Agency User
- **What:** Every table on every screen can be downloaded as a CSV file that holds exactly what that User sees in it.
- **Why:** Not given in Compass's sheet; the sources below are where it comes from.
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §6 Uploads

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** Every table on every screen has a download control that calls [`REQ-INTAKE-0005`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0005) with the rows and columns the User sees in that table.
- **R2.** The screen passes the table's current filters and sort and every page of rows, not only the page on screen.
- **R3.** A column the acting role may not see, such as a Pay Rate for a Unit User, is never passed and so is never in the file.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

<a id="req-shell-0011"></a>

### Show a record's change history

`REQ-SHELL-0011` · first slice

- **Who:** Program User, Unit User, Agency User
- **What:** A screen can show the change history of one record from the Audit Trail: who changed what, when, through which channel, and why. The screen that embeds it decides who may see it.
- **Why:** Know who changed a rate, when and why *(RC-5: Rate change audit trail)*
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §2 Shifts; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) RC-5

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The history lists the AuditEvents of one record, newest first, as [`REQ-AUDIT-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-audit-0001) returns them.
- **R2.** Each entry shows the time, the User who made the change or Iris for a system change, the channel, each changed field with its old and new value, and any reason.
- **R3.** An entry saved from a Proposal says so and names the channel the Proposal came through.
- **R4.** The history only reads, and has no control that changes or removes an entry.
- **R5.** The embedding screen names the record and the roles that see its history, and a field such a role may not see, such as a Pay Rate, is left out.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-37](open-questions.md#d-37) Which records are audited?
- [D-175](open-questions.md#d-175) Can anyone change or remove an Audit Trail entry?

<a id="req-shell-0012"></a>

### List, reopen, rename, and delete Saved Reports

`REQ-SHELL-0012`

- **Who:** Unit User, Program User
- **What:** A Unit User or a Program User sees the reports they saved, reopens any of them, and renames or deletes them. A reopened report is computed again from current records.
- **Why:** Reporting today is Excel exports and a monthly PDF deck *(REP-1: Natural-language reporting: ask a question, get a chart, table or dashboard)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) REP-1; [Demo sessions](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xy3QVWr-aVVV6mpMxWsH6kb987IzwVPXDQ1iW8k83Bo/edit) Reporting

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The Saved Reports list shows only the reports the signed-in User saved, newest first, each with its name, measures, groupings, and period.
- **R2.** Opening one calls [`REQ-REPORTING-0003`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0003) and shows the recomputed chart, table, or dashboard.
- **R3.** A report with a relative period, one of the RelativePeriod values, shows that period in words and the dates it covers today, and one with fixed dates shows those dates.
- **R4.** The Reports screens that depend on this requirement embed the list, and a User with no Saved Report is told that an answer in the assistant can be saved.
- **R5.** Each Saved Report offers Rename, which takes a new name, and Delete, both through [`REQ-REPORTING-0003.R13`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0003).

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-REPORTING-0003` Answer plain-language questions with a chart, table, or dashboard](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0003)

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-74](open-questions.md#d-74) Which relative periods can a Saved Report use?
- [D-108](open-questions.md#d-108) Which rows does a list show first, where no source gives an order?
- [D-125](open-questions.md#d-125) Which weeks, months, and periods do dashboards and reports use?
- [D-185](open-questions.md#d-185) Who can open a Saved Report?
- [D-231](open-questions.md#d-231) What does a list show when it has no rows?

<a id="req-shell-0013"></a>

### Show refusals, empty lists, and Unit times the same way on every screen

`REQ-SHELL-0013` · first slice

- **Who:** Instawork Admin, Program User, Unit User, Agency User
- **What:** Every screen handles a refused action, an empty list, a required reason, and Unit dates and times in the same way. Persona screens state only what differs. It is delivered as the shared parts that do this, which every later screen uses.
- **Why:** Each persona gets its own view *(PLT-1: RBAC: unit (buyer), agency (supplier), corporate/program owner)*
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §7 When the agent is unsure; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) PLT-1

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** When a requirement refuses an action, the screen shows the reason it returned beside that action, keeps what the User typed, and shows no change.
- **R2.** A screen offers an action only to a role that may take it, and only while the record's status allows it.
- **R3.** Where the owning requirement requires a reason, the action cannot be confirmed while the reason is empty.
- **R4.** A list or table with nothing to show says so in words, says when filters are the cause, and then offers to clear them.
- **R5.** Every date and time of a Shift, Release, Timesheet, or Tip Pool is shown in the timezone of its Unit.
- **R6.** Money is shown in US dollars to the cent, exactly as the owning requirement computed it, and is never rounded again on a screen.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-ORG-0009` Allow each action only to its role and scope](business-rules.md#req-org-0009)

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-41](open-questions.md#d-41) How are money amounts rounded?
- [D-119](open-questions.md#d-119) How does a screen show a refused action?
- [D-231](open-questions.md#d-231) What does a list show when it has no rows?
- [D-232](open-questions.md#d-232) In which timezone does a screen show the times of a Shift?

## Iris assistant

The chat panel on every page that takes files and plain-language requests, the Proposal card, and reporting answers.

<a id="req-assistant-0001"></a>

### Open the Iris assistant from any page

`REQ-ASSISTANT-0001`

- **Who:** Program User, Unit User, Agency User
- **What:** Every signed-in page opens the assistant, a chat panel where a User types a request or attaches a file. It opens with starters for the role the User is acting in.
- **Why:** Not given in Compass's sheet; the sources below are where it comes from.
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §7 Agent Chat

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The frame of [`REQ-SHELL-0009`](#req-shell-0009) has a control that opens the assistant as a panel over the page, without leaving it.
- **R2.** The panel has one input for typed text and attached files, and shows the User's messages and Iris's answers in order.
- **R3.** For a Unit User it opens with four starters: book a Shift, upload Shifts, download the Shifts template, and approve recent Timesheets.
- **R4.** For an Agency User the starters are upload a Rate Card, upload Workers, download a template, assign Workers to Shifts, and submit hours and tips.
- **R5.** For a Program User the starters are ask a spend question, upload Units, upload Agencies, upload a Rate Card, and download a template.
- **R6.** A starter opens the file chooser for an upload, gives the template through [`REQ-INTAKE-0003`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0003) for a download, or begins that request in the conversation.
- **R7.** A file attached in the panel is sent through [`REQ-INTAKE-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0001) with channel ASSISTANT, and its status and its Proposal card appear in the conversation.
- **R8.** When Iris cannot tell an attached file's upload type, the panel asks the User to pick one of the types the acting role may send.
- **R9.** When the acting role may not send the file's type, the panel names the roles that may, and nothing is saved.
- **R10.** Each time it opens, the panel lists the User's OPEN Proposals, oldest first, whichever channel they came through, each as the card of [`REQ-ASSISTANT-0002`](#req-assistant-0002).
- **R11.** The conversation lasts for the session only; after sign-out the User still finds their Uploads in the upload log and their OPEN Proposals in the panel.

**Open questions it rests on**

- [D-63](open-questions.md#d-63) Which starters does the assistant offer a Program User?
- [D-211](open-questions.md#d-211) Is a conversation with the assistant kept?

<a id="req-assistant-0002"></a>

### Show every Proposal as a card to approve

`REQ-ASSISTANT-0002`

- **Who:** Program User, Unit User, Agency User
- **What:** Wherever a Proposal is shown it is one card: the items ready, the items that need review with each problem and suggested fix, and the actions to decide it. After apply, the card shows what was saved.
- **Why:** Not given in Compass's sheet; the sources below are where it comes from.
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §7 Agent Chat; [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §6 Uploads

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The card shows the Proposal's summary, how many items have no problem, and how many need review.
- **R2.** Each item that needs review shows its file row number, if any, and each problem's field, message, fix, and candidates, and says the fix applies unless a candidate is picked.
- **R3.** On each such item the User accepts the fix, edits the values, or rejects the item, and one action accepts every undecided item; each calls [`REQ-AGENT-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-agent-0002).
- **R4.** An item with no problem can also be opened, edited, or rejected, and is otherwise saved as proposed.
- **R5.** A card shows values as the owning requirement priced or checked them, such as each Shift line's Agency and Bill Rate on a REQUEST_DRAFT or each share on a TIP_ENTRY.
- **R6.** The apply action states how many items it will save and is disabled while an item with a problem has no decision.
- **R7.** Reject all calls [`REQ-AGENT-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-agent-0002) to reject the Proposal, and nothing is saved.
- **R8.** After apply, the card says how many items were saved, lists each FAILED_RECHECK item with its result_message, and links to the menu screen that lists the saved records, when the menu has one.
- **R9.** A decided Proposal's card is read-only, and it says that a failed item is retried by sending the file or request again.
- **R10.** Only the User the Proposal was made for can open its card; anyone else is shown the refusal of [`REQ-AGENT-0002`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-agent-0002).
- **R11.** Where a problem carries candidates, such as Workers with the same name, the item lists them and the User picks at most one, as [`REQ-AGENT-0002.R20`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-agent-0002) provides.

<a id="req-assistant-0003"></a>

### Hand each typed request to the requirement that owns it

`REQ-ASSISTANT-0003`

- **Who:** Program User, Unit User, Agency User
- **What:** The assistant passes each typed request to the product requirement that owns that kind of change, and shows its question, Proposal, or answer. The assistant itself saves nothing.
- **Why:**
  - Faster than forms; handles partial info and asks for what's missing *(SC-9: Natural-language booking in the app ("3 bartenders and 2 line cooks Monday"))*
  - Fast handling of edge cases *(TS-6: Natural-language timesheet edits ("Grace moved to bartender at 3:45"))*
- **Sources:** [PRD](https://instawork.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ec/pages/4841898227/Compass+VMS+Product+Requirements) §7 Agent Chat; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) SC-9; [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) TS-6; [Demo sessions](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xy3QVWr-aVVV6mpMxWsH6kb987IzwVPXDQ1iW8k83Bo/edit) Timesheets, Tips & Expenses

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** A typed request is read under [`REQ-AGENT-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-agent-0001) and handed to exactly one owner named below, and the assistant makes no change of its own.
- **R2.** A Unit User's request for Workers goes to [`REQ-ORDERING-0009`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0009), which drafts the Request.
- **R3.** A request to change hours, split a Timesheet, mark a no-show, or approve or submit Timesheets goes to [`REQ-TIME-0004`](business-rules.md#req-time-0004).
- **R4.** A Unit User's request to enter a Tip Pool goes to [`REQ-TIPS-0004`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0004), an Agency User's to enter a Worker's tip to [`REQ-TIPS-0001`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0001), and an Agency User's to add Expenses to [`REQ-TIPS-0002`](business-rules.md#req-tips-0002).
- **R5.** An Agency User's request that names Workers for a Shift goes to [`REQ-WORKFORCE-0018`](business-rules.md#req-workforce-0018), which returns a Proposal of kind WORKER_ASSIGNMENT.
- **R6.** A question about spend or labor from a Unit User or a Program User goes to [`REQ-REPORTING-0003`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0003).
- **R7.** An attached file is not routed here; it goes through [`REQ-INTAKE-0001`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-intake-0001), and the owner of its upload type checks and saves its rows.
- **R8.** When a request fits several owners or is missing a detail, the assistant shows the question [`REQ-AGENT-0003`](behind-the-scenes.md#req-agent-0003) asks and hands nothing on until the User answers.
- **R9.** When the owner says the acting role may not make the change, the assistant says who can, and no Proposal is created.
- **R10.** A Unit User's request to change a Shift's headcount or times, or to cancel it, goes to [`REQ-ORDERING-0015`](business-rules.md#req-ordering-0015), which returns a Proposal of kind SHIFT_CHANGE.
- **R11.** Each Proposal an owner returns is shown as the card of [`REQ-ASSISTANT-0002`](#req-assistant-0002) in the conversation.
- **R12.** A request that no owner above takes creates no Proposal, and the assistant says it cannot make that change.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-TIME-0004` Edit Timesheets in plain language](business-rules.md#req-time-0004)
- [`REQ-TIPS-0001` Hold each Timesheet's tips and take the tips an Agency enters](business-rules.md#req-tips-0001)
- [`REQ-TIPS-0004` Split Tip Pools by hours and credit cashier PIN tips](business-rules.md#req-tips-0004)
- [`REQ-TIPS-0002` Add and approve expenses](business-rules.md#req-tips-0002)

<a id="req-assistant-0004"></a>

### Answer reporting questions in the assistant and save the answer

`REQ-ASSISTANT-0004`

- **Who:** Unit User, Program User
- **What:** A Unit User or a Program User asks a question about spend or labor in the assistant and sees the answer there as a chart, a table, or a dashboard. They can save it as a Saved Report.
- **Why:** Reporting today is Excel exports and a monthly PDF deck *(REP-1: Natural-language reporting: ask a question, get a chart, table or dashboard)*
- **Sources:** [Compass sheet](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SlUyWtbhik3KEKW4VAskSAEfS8v3S-_OjgVfZpA2WM4/edit) REP-1; [Demo sessions](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Xy3QVWr-aVVV6mpMxWsH6kb987IzwVPXDQ1iW8k83Bo/edit) Reporting

**Acceptance criteria**

- **R1.** The answer [`REQ-REPORTING-0003`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0003) returns appears in the conversation as a chart or a table for one measure, and as a dashboard for several.
- **R2.** Each answer states the measures, groupings, filters, and dates it used, so the User can see how the question was read.
- **R3.** When [`REQ-REPORTING-0003`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0003) asks which measure or period is meant, the question appears in the conversation and no number is shown until the User answers.
- **R4.** Each answer offers Save, which asks for a name and keeps it as a Saved Report through [`REQ-REPORTING-0003`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0003).
- **R5.** A table in an answer downloads through [`REQ-SHELL-0010`](#req-shell-0010).
- **R6.** An Agency User who asks such a question is told that reports are for Unit Users and Program Users, and gets no numbers.
- **R7.** A measure [`REQ-REPORTING-0003`](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0003) returns as not available is shown in those words, never as zero or a blank.

**Business rules it saves through**

- [`REQ-REPORTING-0003` Answer plain-language questions with a chart, table, or dashboard](business-rules.md#req-reporting-0003)
